title: Inscriptiones Alborum Amicorum (IAA)
institution: University of Szeged, University Library (Miklós Latzkovits, Lajos Adamik, László Bujtás and others)
notes: Database of entries (inscriptions, mottoes, dedications, signatures, owners' notes) in 16th-18th century alba amicorum with a Hungarian connection: entries by Hungarians or owners from Hungary, entries made in Hungary, and entries mentioning Hungary. Each record separates the date, place, motto, dedication, signature and quoted or composed inscription text, with scans where permitted. Record numbers run to about 17,090, and the database covers the 16th to the 18th century. Status active: copyright line 2003-2026 and the database is described as continuously growing. The counts cover the entries dated 1450-1700 that have transcribed text, and 327 entries with only metadata or notes are left out. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
license_note: The site shows '© Latzkovits, Miklós 2003-2026' and no open licence. The about page says any further use of the entry photographs is allowed only with permission of the album's current owner or holding collection.
